steps.title: What is changing here?
steps.body: Every NASA variable that applies to this wetland is tested. Its ponds are not simply waiting for rain.

steps.title: Is it real, or is it chance?
steps.body: From space, most ponds now flood less than rain and heat alone would allow. The gap is measured, not guessed.

steps.title: Is it the climate?
steps.body: The park is protected. The aquifer that feeds it is not. Water pumped for berries and for a beach town never reaches the ponds.

narrative: One lagoon dried twice in fifty years, then three years in a row. Rain explains part of it. The pumps explain the rest.
caveats: The aquifer reaches far beyond the park boundary.
Drought makes it worse; it does not start it.
